scripts.test: bun run test:core && bun run test:routes
scripts.test:core: bun test --max-concurrency=1 test/worker.test.ts test/frontmatter.test.ts test/slugify.test.ts test/translator.test.ts test/lib test/repos
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:coverage:core && bun run test:coverage:routes
scripts.test:coverage:core: bun test --max-concurrency=1 --coverage --coverage-reporter=text test/worker.test.ts test/frontmatter.test.ts test/slugify.test.ts test/translator.test.ts test/lib test/repos
